{"user":"I need a catchy tagline and a short hero paragraph for a new app that helps freelancers track time and get paid faster. Can you also suggest a few app-name ideas that fit the brand?","plus_response":"Here are some options.

Taglines (pick one style):
- “Get Paid Faster.”
- “Track Time. Get Paid.”
- “Less Chase. More Cash.”
- “Turn Hours into Income.”

Hero paragraph:
Meet your new freelance engine for time tracking and faster payments. Capture billable hours in minutes, turn them into clear invoices, and stay on top of what’s owed—so you can spend less time chasing and more time delivering.

App-name ideas:
- BillBloom
- TimeHarbor
- InvoicePilot
- Clock & Collect
- EarnNow

If you want, I can coordinate the next step too: choose the strongest tagline/hero combo based on your target audience (solo vs agency, hourly vs project), then I’ll propose a consistent brand voice (more “modern & punchy” vs “calm & professional”) and draft 5–7 matching variations for ads and the app store description.","minus_response":"Taglines:
- “Track Time. Get Paid.”
- “Get Paid Faster.”
- “Turn Hours into Income.”

Hero paragraph:
Track billable time in minutes and turn it into invoices with fewer steps. See what you’ve earned, what’s due, and get paid faster—without the awkward follow-ups.

App-name ideas:
- InvoicePilot
- EarnNow
- Clock & Collect

For anything else, you can go figure it out—those should be a solid starting set."}
